LIVER: no abstract found that states a guanidinium / creatine exchange rate or chemical shift measured in liver. PMID 41917000 (2026, Nat Commun, SSE-CEST) images creatine 'amine' in human liver and ex vivo porcine liver but gives no kex or ppm in the abstract. A liver simulation therefore has to BORROW: human in vivo skeletal muscle at 3 T (Cr 150 +/- 70 s^-1, PCr 185 +/- 105 s^-1; PMID 42249575), animal in vivo brain (Cr 200-480 s^-1 at 3-11.7 T; pool-averaged guanidinium ~300-420 s^-1), or solution (~1000 s^-1 comparator, 1499 Hz WEX extrapolation to pH 7.1/37 C). Shift for creatine guanidinium: 1.9-2.0 ppm in all abstracts (1.9, 1.95, 2.0, 'about 2'); PCr additional peak at 2.5-2.6 ppm. In-tissue rates are consistently 2-5x lower than solution values.
